messages:
Sam (docs): Quick heads-up — I'm opening a bulk PR to standardize our rate-cap examples across the SDK snippets and the usage dashboard panels. Goal: consistent tier examples + fix stale links in the Quota matrix panel.

Eli (eng-runtime): Can you drop the PR link? +1 for standardization. Will the PR touch samples that mention internal feature flags? We should avoid leaking that.

Sam (docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 :eyes: It replaces code blocks in /guides/rate-limits and /sdk-examples with calls to the new header `x-rw-quota` example and updates the dashboard JSON for the usage-matrix panel.

Priya (product): Is this copy-only or could it accidentally change customer-facing pricing language? If any wording implies a new charge model we need finance/legal looped in.

Sam (docs): Only examples, labels, and a brief clarifying sentence about burst credits. No price changes. Meredith, can you give finance a quick once-over?

Meredith (devex): On it. Also please include minimal SDK snippets for py/ts/go and annotate estimated token impact per example. Keeps folks from pasting heavy examples into docs.

Jordan (analytics): Heads-up: exported dashboard panels now require `unit_scale` or some panels misrender. I pasted a tiny export below that you can reuse.

docs-bot: export attached:
```
{"panel_id":"usage-matrix-v2","unit_scale":"tokens","panels":3}
```

Eli (eng-runtime): Note: runtime accepts `x-rw-quota` but legacy clients use `x-rate-cap`. Please add a fallback snippet showing both to avoid regressions.

Sam (docs): Good catch. I'll add a fallback example block: 
```
# recommended
headers = {"x-rw-quota": "tier:pro;limit:50000"}
# fallback for older SDKs
headers_legacy = {"x-rate-cap": "50000"}
```

Priya (product): Add a short migration note: "If your middleware parses headers, prefer `x-rw-quota` and map legacy headers to it." Keeps integrators safe.

Meredith (devex): I'll proofread after PR opens. Sam, can you run a linkcheck across the changed files? I can help triage failures.

Sam (docs): Will run `scripts/linkcheck.sh docs/guides/*.md docs/sdk-examples/**/*.md` before requesting review. Also updating the micro-batching example to match runtime defaults.

Eli (eng-runtime): FYI the TS micro-batching sample still shows `batchSize: 8` — runtime default is now 16 for latency/cost tradeoff. Update to reflect SLO recommendations.

Jordan (analytics): When you update dashboard JSON, tag it `compat:v2` so the release importer picks it up. If you can add a tiny panel rendering unit test that exercises `unit_scale` that would be ideal.

Sam (docs): Plan: open PR now, tag reviewers @Eli @Meredith @Jordan, run linkcheck + dashboard import locally, iterate on feedback. I'll post the PR link here once CI finishes.

Meredith (devex): :thumbsup: Ping here when CI passes and I'll do a final pass on examples and language.

Eli (eng-runtime): Thanks — extra :eyes: on fallback header sample.

Sam (docs): Thanks all — starting the run now.
